_comment: Values read from CKB testnet (2026-05-31 treasury-enabled registry deployment).
registrySpec: RegistrySpecLike for FirewallConfig.registries - matches by type_id_value (bytes 34..66 of v2 type args).
canonicalRegistryCell: live BLKL v2 registry cell bootstrapped with v3 governance header and treasury lock script.
canonicalRegistryCell.typeArgs: 66-byte v2 type args (version=0x02 | gov_code_hash(32) | gov_hash_type(1) | type_id_value(32)).
firewallLockDeployOutPoint and spawnAwareSecp256k1DeployOutPoint are unchanged from the 2026-05-20 deployment.
governanceLockDeployOutPoint: GOV1 v4 governance-lock enforcing review-window since semantics.
proposalAnchorDeployOutPoint: proposal-anchor type script for treasury-funded PBLK anchors.

deploymentHistory.note: 0.2.0 release — v1 contract upgrade; placeholder governance-lock
v2 full deployment — real governance-lock with secp256k1 multisig; blacklist-registry with CellInput struct fix; BLKL v2 registry bootstrapped with testnet committee
GOV1 v3 redeployment — governance-lock and blacklist-registry redeployed; registry re-bootstrapped with rotated testnet governance keys
proposal-anchor type script deployed for treasury-funded PBLK anchors and consensus-enforced reclaim
Treasury-enabled blacklist-registry redeployed and canonical testnet registry re-bootstrapped with BLKL v2 data carrying a v3 governance header and dedicated public treasury seed cell.

proposal-anchor redeployed (Type ID upgrade) — fixed bytes::Bytes Arc atomic opcodes (lr/sc) by replacing high_level::load_script molecule path with raw syscall load_script into Vec<u8>; binary is now 19560 bytes with 0 atomic instructions

governance-lock and proposal-anchor redeployed together (combined Type ID upgrade TX) — governance-lock upgraded to signer-free GOV1 v4 validator-vote model; proposal-anchor included to provide capacity for the larger binary (97024 bytes vs 94632 bytes old binary)

governance-lock redeployed (Type ID upgrade) — fixed sha256 outer hash: noble/curves secp256k1 applies SHA-256 internally before ECDSA; governance-lock now matches with sha256(blake2b(canonical)) as the vote signing message hash (binary 98224 bytes)

proposal-anchor redeployed (Type ID upgrade) — fixed INVALID_RECLAIM_SINCE (error 36): relative_timestamp_since_ms was returning seconds but comparing to reclaim_delay_ms in milliseconds; fix multiplies since seconds by 1000 before comparison (binary 19568 bytes)
Phase 4 governance drill executed — proposal 7a3ebccd3e7d (add 0xababababababababab... to blacklist) confirmed on-chain; end-to-end GOV1 v4 governance flow validated on testnet

treasury.note: Ordinary bootstrap change was sent to a different local testnet account so treasury discovery reports only treasury cells.
